memories.content: Marguerite is the owner of the Copper Kettle bistro. She usually replies to reviews within days, often defensively. She knows the bistro was short two servers on the night in question.

A one-star review of the Copper Kettle bistro complaining about a 45-minute wait on a night the bistro was short two servers was posted on a major review site last night. Marguerite can see the review and can post a public reply on the site.
